widgets.widgetName: Name(s) as shown on your California tax return
California Secretary of State file number (12 digits)
Part I, Section A, Line 1. Basic research payments paid or incurred during the taxable year. See instructions
Line 10. Enter fixed-base percentage, but not more than 16% (.16). See instructions
Line 11. Enter average annual gross receipts. See instructions
Line 12. Base amount. Multiply line 11 by the percentage on line 10
Line 13. Subtract line 12 from line 9. If zero or less, enter 0
Line 14. Multiply line 9 by 50% (.50). See instructions
Line 15. Enter the smaller of line 13 or line 14
Line 16. Multiply line 15 by 15% (.15)
17a. Regular credit. Add line 4 and line 16. If you do not elect the reduced credit under I R C Section 280C(c), enter the result here, and see instructions for the schedule to attach

Line 17b. Reduced regular credit under I R C Section 280C(c). Multiply line 17a by the applicable percentage below: 87.7% (.877) for individuals, estates, and trusts. 91.16% (.9116) for corporations. 98.5% (.985) for S corporations. Enter the reduced credit amount. See instructions
Line 2. Base period amount. See instructions
Line 3. Subtract line 2 from line 1. If less than zero, enter 0
Line 4. Multiply line 3 by 24% (.24)
Line 5. Wages for qualified services. See instructions
Line 6. Cost of supplies. See instructions
Line 7. Rental or lease costs of computers. See instructions
Line 8. Enter the applicable percentage of contract research expenses. See instructions
Line 9. Total qualified research expenses. Add line 5 through line 8
Section B, Line 18. Basic research payments paid or incurred during the taxable year. See instructions
Line 19. Base period amount. See instructions
Line 20. Subtract line 19 from line 18. If less than zero, enter 0
Line 21. Multiply line 20 by 24% (.24)
Line 22. Wages for qualified services. See instructions
Line 23. Cost of supplies. See instructions
Line 24. Rental or lease costs of computers. See instructions
Line 25. Enter the applicable percentage of contract research expenses. See instructions
Line 26. Total qualified research expenses. Add line 22 through line 25
Line 27. Enter the total qualified research expenses for the prior 3 taxable years. If there are no Q R E s in any 1 of those years, skip lines 28 and 29. See instructions
Line 28. Divide line 27 by 6
Line 29. Subtract line 28 from line 26. If zero or less, enter 0
Line 30. Multiply line 29 by 3% (.03) If you skipped lines 28 and 29, multiply line 26 by 1.3% (0.013)

Line 31a. Alternative simplified credit. Add lines 21 and 30. If you do not elect the reduced credit under I R C Section 280C(c), enter the result here, and see instructions for the schedule that must be attached

Line 31b. Reduced alternative incremental credit under I R C Section 280C(c). Multiply line 31a by the applicable percentage below: 87.7% (.877) for individuals, estates, and trusts. 91.16% (.9116) for corporations. 98.5% (.985) for S corporations. Enter the reduced credit amount. See instructions
Section C, Line 32. Pass-through research credit(s) from S corporations, estates, trusts, partnerships, and L L Cs. See instructions

Line 33. Current year research credit. If you did not elect the reduced credit under I R C Section 280C(c), add line 17a or line 31a to line 32 and enter the result here. If you elected the reduced credit under I R C Section 280C(c), add line 17b or line 31b to line 32 and enter the result here
Line 34. Enter the amount of credit on line 33 that is from passive activities. If none of the amount on line 33 is from passive activities, enter 0
Line 35. Subtract line 34 from line 33
Line 36. Enter the allowable credit from passive activities. See instructions
Line 37. Non-passive activity credit carryover from prior year. (Do not include credits received through assignment.) See instructions
Line 38. Total. Add line 35 through line 37
Part II, Line 39. Credit claimed. Enter the amount of the credit claimed on the current year tax return. See instructions. (Do not include any assigned credit claimed on form F T B 3544, Part B.)
Line 40. Total credit assigned. Enter the total amount from form F T B 3544, Part A, column (g). If you are not a corporation, enter 0. See instructions
Line 41. Credit amount to be elected as refundable in future years. See instructions
Line 42. Credit carryover available for use or assignment for future years. Subtract lines 39, 40, and 41 from line 38
